checks.detail: Godot contract passed; initial authored-import budget 600s

Full milestone assessment remains incomplete. Ordinary progression independently covered unarmed entry, quest acceptance, sword acquisition, practice hit/defense and retry, initial enemy defeat and XP pickup, bow acquisition and charged target hit, lamp revelation/investigation, first upgrade, and lightning practice. Bridge encounters, pillar group, supply branch, chapter exit, and the complete opening/recovery matrix remain unverified. Camera-integrity and environment-readability patrols passed in sampled village views: grounded human scale, readable terrain/buildings, visible player, and no observed camera obstruction or material failure. The immediately next chapter-entry boundary has insufficient runtime evidence. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.dd00cab9b09b=insufficient_evidence;

Both tracker task conditions pass independently, including genuine wrapping at both resolutions. Empty and earned-equipment bag focus, B-roll/I-bag separation, journal/settings return, held-input suppression, dialogue HUD restoration, and ordinary Continue preservation were observed. Continue retained XP, ammunition, equipment, skill choice and committed progress. R04 remains unassessed in full because protection changes and repeated-acquisition nonduplication were not demonstrated. Developer risk handoff was treated as context; its previously missing tracker, nonempty-bag and held-input observations were independently collected. First-event HUD coverage remains incomplete. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.b9367395950a=insufficient_evidence;

Teaching progression, failed-defense retry, real sword hit, bow target hit, lamp revelation/investigation and lightning practice were observed through ordinary controls. Full R22 coverage remains incomplete: the complete demonstration, retry, reward-repeat, contact/audio/VFX and deadlock matrix was not assessed. A concrete pursuit defect was observed in the legally reached initial encounter: the engaged enemy remained stationary with navigation_ready=false and no path. This prevents closure of the selected actor issue. Risk-weighted discovery covered bag focus, nested journal return, held movement at resume, earned progression and Continue persistence. Distant endings and unrelated audio/settings matrices were skipped as lower priority outside the tracker repair. No disclosed tester_* setup action applied. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.5884b37f8b89=fail;

Require candidate-bound runtime evidence for this milestone; future milestones remain pending, and previously verified behavior must be preserved. This milestone review does not waive any final PRD requirement.

task_requirements.requirement: For a short tracked objective at 1280×720 and 1920×1080, settled tracker position, size and minimum after 100→150→200→100% equal their initial values for both expanded and collapsed states.
